claims.claim: A machine-verifiable scientific record requires a governance layer in addition to provenance in order to scale review across independent actors.
claims.source_locator: Paper 01 design synthesis and worked cases
claims.evidence: The current packet motivates and decomposes the thesis but does not empirically establish necessity.
claims.notes: Frame as the program thesis or design requirement until the closest-work and counterexample analysis is complete.

claims.claim: Topic-local root-relative trust with controlled bridges reduces capture or cross-topic contamination relative to a global recursive score.
claims.source_locator: Paper 02 MODEL.md candidate results and A0-A4 comparison
claims.evidence: A model and experiment plan exist; no proof, counterexample audit, or simulation result exists yet.

claims.claim: Fresh case personas can provide public unlinkability together with private accountability in the proposed review lifecycle.
claims.source_locator: Paper 03 threat model and unimplemented roadmap tests
claims.evidence: The v0.1 prototype has no identity, credential, signature, nullifier, opening, or appeal implementation.
claims.notes: Do not use anonymity language beyond a proposed threat model.

claims.claim: The consolidated protocol is operationally useful to independent scientific communities under malicious, uninformed, and institutionally powerful actors.
claims.evidence: No independent-actor pilot or human-subject evidence exists.
claims.notes: Requires ethics-cleared pilot and plural outcomes including harms.

claims.claim: The named candidate venue will permit publication without author fees through a diamond route, waiver, subscription route, or RIT agreement.
claims.evidence: Prior venue research exists, but exact title, article type, corresponding-author eligibility, caps, and agreement dates are time-dependent.
claims.notes: Reverify at target selection and immediately before submission.
